Note::is_rank3¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

bool Note::is_rank3() const noexcept

Ask About Geometry, Not Payload¶

is_rank3() reports whether a defined Note has exactly three axes. Rank three is the largest geometry supported by Note and is often used for a sequence of matrix-shaped text or typed-lane blocks. The method does not assign meaning to those axes and does not inspect, convert, or allocate cell data.

Rank and cardinality are independent. Shapes [1, 1, 1], [2, 0, 3], and [0, 4, 5] are all rank three even though the latter two contain no cells. A matrix with one cell remains rank two. Undefined handles return false, which makes this predicate safe in validation branches without a preceding defined() check.

The operation is constant-time, allocation-free, and noexcept. Use dim() when the numeric rank itself is needed, or slabs() when a confirmed rank-three Note must be decomposed into rank-two Note views.

Example 1: A Dense Rank-Three Note¶

const auto value = pluss::note::make(
    std::vector<std::string>{"a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h"},
    std::array<std::int64_t, 3>{2, 2, 2});
std::cout << std::boolalpha
          << "rank3=" << value.is_rank3()
          << " dim=" << value.dim()
          << " numel=" << value.numel() << '\n';

Output¶

rank3=true dim=3 numel=8

Example 2: Zero Extents Do Not Change Rank¶

const auto value = pluss::note::make(
    std::vector<std::string>{}, std::array<std::int64_t, 3>{1, 2, 0});
std::cout << std::boolalpha
          << "rank3=" << value.is_rank3()
          << " empty=" << value.empty()
          << " last=" << value.size(-1) << '\n';

Output¶

rank3=true empty=true last=0

Example 3: A Matrix Is Not Promoted Implicitly¶

const auto matrix = pluss::note::make({{"a", "b"}});
std::cout << std::boolalpha
          << "matrix=" << matrix.is_matrix()
          << " rank3=" << matrix.is_rank3() << '\n';

Output¶

matrix=true rank3=false

Example 4: Undefined Handles Are Safely False¶

const auto absent = pluss::Note::undefined();
std::cout << std::boolalpha
          << "defined=" << absent.defined()
          << " rank3=" << absent.is_rank3() << '\n';

Output¶

defined=false rank3=false

is_rank3() is a query only. Use unsqueeze(), squeeze(), or reshape() when a deliberate geometry change is required.

See Also¶

  • dim: return the numeric rank.

  • is_matrix: test for exactly two axes.

  • is_scalar: test for rank zero.

  • slabs: decompose rank three into owning rank-two views.
